comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Orthopedic pain, bone healing and cartilage products sold to orthopedic surgeons; not chronic wound care skin substitutes.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Makes regenerative tissue matrices and wound care products for hospitals; partial overlap with Organogenesis's dermal matrices, though broader in neurosurgery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Non-opioid injectable drugs for surgical pain; different products and customers' needs, no wound care overlap.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Home-use compression devices for lymphedema, rented or sold with reimbursement; different product and treatment than tissue-based wound products.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Spine implants and bone grafts sold to spine surgeons; different clinical specialty than chronic wound skin substitutes.
